name: Waymo One
sub: Benchmark robotaxi with hundreds of thousands of paid weekly rides
leadership: Tekedra Mawakana and Dmitri Dolgov, co-CEOs
about: Waymo’s consumer robotaxi service and the benchmark scaled rider-only AV service.
model: Per-ride revenue through Waymo app and partner platforms.
deployment: Multiple US metros; Uber in Austin/Atlanta; Lyft Nashville.
metrics: About 500,000 paid rides per week (July 2026); fully open in Miami and Orlando with 150,000+ riders served off the interest list; invite-only Waymo Premier membership ($29.99/month) began in SF, LA and Phoenix.
signal: Phoenix Uber pilot ended; other distribution channels remain active.
